items.hed: Rockets host Boston tonight at Toyota Center, 8:30 p.m. ET
items.insight: NBA.com lists Boston at Houston for Monday, Nov. 2, at 7:30 p.m. CT, 8:30 p.m. ET, at Toyota Center. The Rockets come in off Saturday's 119-98 win over Oklahoma City, which moved them to 6-1. Jabari Smith Jr. scored 30 in that game and Marcus Smart added 24.

items.hed: Texans come off the bye with a Sunday trip to the Chargers
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule has Week 9 on Sunday, Nov. 8, at the Los Angeles Chargers, SoFi Stadium, 3:05 p.m. CT on CBS. Then come Cleveland on Nov. 15 and a Thursday night home game against Indianapolis on Nov. 19 on Prime Video.

items.hed: Astros' offseason so far: six players elected free agency, one release
items.insight: MLB's official transaction log lists six Astros electing free agency on Oct. 29: right-hander Bryan Abreu, center fielder Daulton Varsho, catcher Christian Vázquez, first baseman LaMonte Wade Jr., right-hander Enyel De Los Santos, and left-hander Steven Okert. Houston released left fielder Nelson Velázquez on Oct. 27. The log shows no newer Astros moves as of Monday morning.
